profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Law School Admission Council
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the mental health care industry. Skilled in .NET Framework, C#, Javascript, TypeScript, PL/SQL and well versed in all of the Agile Methodologies. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor of Science (B.S.) focused in Information Sciences & Technology and a Master of Engineering (MEng) degree both from Penn State University.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Full-stack development, front-end programming & back-end programming.
-ASP.NET Framework, MVC, C#, HTML, Javascript, TypeScript, Bootstrap.
-TherapyNotes is the homegrown application that we develop.
-Several client-based application development.
-Built application using SPA architecture.

positions.title: IT Application Solutions Intern
positions.description:
-Worked with IT Website Redesign team, created the Colorcon downtime static website pages for all four regions.
-Worked with IT security team to add/delete security responsibilities for new & former employees.
-Performed security tasks & troubleshooting issues within new Colorcon Jive social business platform.
-Managed OneSource Portal (File distribution & management application) upgrade project.
-Train first level IT support resources on system applications within the company.
-Part of the IT Mobility project to setup and distribute iPhones with Colorcon standardized requirements.

positions.title: IT Summer Intern
positions.description:
-Worked on Oracle R12 Project with IT department.
-Performed tasks within new Qualify ticketing software.
-Part of the lead team for presenting/distributing/consulting on new software throughout company globally.
-Performed problem-solving for implementing software throughout the company with IT department.
-Data entry and computer assistance on new software.
-Provided support to IT security team on role-based security within application systems.
